exposure: Gestational age at termination: <=22 weeks (Group 1) and >23 weeks (Group 2)
cohort: 417 pregnant women who underwent termination of pregnancy due to suspected fetal anomaly at a Turkish tertiary referral center between May 2016 and May 2019.
finding: The majority of pregnancy terminations in the later gestational age group (>23 weeks) were due to multiple malformations and/or central nervous system defects, while all chromosomal diseases were detected in the earlier gestational age group (<=22 weeks).
